label: Copper Ridge
description: Warm limestone, bronze and burnished copper — a sophisticated palette inspired by natural stone and warm metal. Modern, clean and premium — suits architects, interior designers, space planners and home renovation studios.
notes: Tokens only — sections never hardcode colours, they read these as CSS variables. The warm limestone bg and bronze primary give this theme its architectural, earthy feel. Poppins is a clean geometric sans-serif that reads as modern and architectural. The copper accent is warm enough for WCAG AA. Changing `primary` here restyles every section, every page, instantly.
